pages.text: The Energy Generator, the "first pot" that burns fuel into power.$(br)It has 10 upgrade slots; stuff in $(2,4)Energy Production Upgrade Components$(0) to boost output (each ×1.75, up to 10). Fuel in, power out, forever.

$(2,4)Want power at scale?$(0) The old "Small Assembly" and "Super Architecture" have retired, replaced by the $(2,4)Generator Matrix$(0): enclose a sealed space with matrix casings and mount the controller and ports on the walls, and output climbs in leaps and bounds.$(br)See the "Matrix Structures" entry for the layout.
